One Of The Most Bizarre Marijuana Arrests Ever. There Was No Marijuana!
A Reader Is Charged With Five Felonies For Having Grow Lights In Storage.
He Asks How He Can Fight Back.

April 19, 1999

From A Reader:

I am a 26 year graduate of the State University of New York College at Fredonia (where I saw you debate a former Drug Czar in 1994).

I graduated with degrees in both History and Secondary Education with the intent of becoming a High School Social Studies teacher.

Last month, I was arrested for cultivation of marijuana. The Sheriff's Department Drug Task Force did not catch me in the act of growing. They seized my grow equipment out of a storage locker.

The sum of their evidence consists of the grow equipment and a statement coerced from my roommate that said that there had been plants in the house in the past (when I was busted, I did not have any plants). Based on this evidence (or lack thereof) the police seized my car, made me spend a night in the County Jail, and charged me with five felonies.

I have hired an excellent law firm (NORML Legal Committee members), and I am sure that they will keep me out of jail, and get me through this ordeal.

I would like to join NORML and every other legalization group in the country, however all of my money is currently going to my lawyers, and after that I will be forced to buy back my car from the County Sheriffs Department.

I am an educated and well-spoken person, and my experiences have made me want to channel my energies into some sort of legalization activism. How does a busted grower with no car, and no money go about doing this? In addition to this, do you have any suggestions about what I can do to improve my legal situation?

Sincerely,

E

(Marijuananews note: As I told E, his case is a first for me. I have never heard of a charge without any marijuana anywhere.

Of course, even if he is acquitted, which seems very possible, he will still have an arrest record and be out the cost of the defense.

But he certainly has the right attitude and asked the right questions. How can the victims fight back?

It does not take any money to be an Internet activist.

One of the best ways is to sign-up with Mapinc –

And, naturally, work MarijuanaNews into every conversation!

The Internet is our medium, and it is the major reason that we are going to win.)
